name: Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp.
summary: Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp. is a Taiwanese company primarily engaged in the manufacturing and distribution of animal feed within Taiwan. Their product portfolio encompasses a variety of specialized feeds: for poultry, they provide layer feed formulated for ducks and chickens, breeder feed for geese, and specific formulations for local poultry varieties. Regarding livestock, they offer feeds tailored for various stages of swine, including piglets, sows, and hogs. Beyond feed, the company also supplies eggs. Established in 1958, Morn Sun Feed Mill Corp. maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan.
